chunks: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: God has not distributed among His servants anything more superior than the intellect. Thus, the sleep of the intelligent person is superior to the vigil of the ignorant, and the staying of the intelligent person is superior to the going out of the ignorant;
and God never sent a Prophet or a Messenger until He had perfected the intellect for him, and his intellect was superior to the entirety of his community's intellects.

And whatever the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) conceals within himself is superior to the striving of the strivers; and a servant does not fulfill the obligations of God until he comprehends them with intellect; and all the worshippers would not reach, in the merit of their worship, what the intelligent person reaches.
And the people of intellect, they are those possessing understanding of whom God the Exalted said: 'And none will take heed except those possessing understanding.'

key_terms.أولو الألباب: Those possessing understanding — Quranic term for those who truly comprehend divine guidance
key_terms.العقل: The intellect/reason — the faculty that enables human beings to understand divine obligations and discern truth
key_terms.سهر الجاهل: The vigil of the ignorant — outward religious effort without intellectual grounding
key_terms.فرائض الله: The obligations of God — religious duties that can only be truly fulfilled through intellectual comprehension
key_terms.يستكمل: To perfect/complete — God perfects the intellect of Prophets and Messengers before their mission

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the intellect being the greatest gift from God?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) exalts the intellect ('aql) as the greatest divine gift to humanity, surpassing all outward acts of worship and striving. This hadith was narrated in the context of the Shia theological emphasis on 'aql as the foundation of religious obligation — one cannot fulfill duties to God without first comprehending them through reason. The quotation from Quran 13:19 identifies the people of intellect (ulu al-albab) as those who truly benefit from divine revelation.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin MuhammadBin Khalid, from oe of his companions, raising it, said, 
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has not Distributed for the servants anything more superior than the intellect. Thus, the sleep of the intellectual is superior to the vigil of the ignorant, and the staying (at home) of the intellectual is superior than going out of the ignorant;

and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> neither Sent a Prophet<sup>as</sup> nor a Rasool<sup>as</sup> until He<sup>azwj</sup> Perfected the intellect (for him<sup>as</sup>), and his<sup>as</sup> intellect happened to be superior to the entirety of the intellects of the community.

And whatever the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> concealed within himself<sup>saww</sup> is superior to the striving of the strivers; and the servant would not fulfil the Obligations of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> until he knows about Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and the entirety of the worshippers would not reach in merit with their worshipping what the intellectual would reach;
and the intellectuals, they are those possessing understanding whom Allahazwj Speaks of [13:19] But rather, only those possessing understanding will mind’.
